notes: «سمعت كعب الاحبار يقول» makes Ka'b the last link (rule 5); «إن في كتابنا» is his saying.

«فقلنا: هو هذا؟ قال: لا» and «قال: نعم»: the text does not name who answers, so no link is added. The Imams al-Hasan and al-Husayn pass in the scene and do not speak. The footnote numbers (3) and (1) are not part of the chain.
